_readme: S730 title hunt (elumen_2 group), 2026-11-25, round 2. Sam asked on 2026-11-25 for each college's printed local subject titles (the catalog's heading for each course subject code), which decide a local code's common subject (kb/subject_title_hunt/README.md). Round 1 (run 45624782074) loaded each courses view whole; its log ran past what a session reads back. This read prints only what names a subject: the two lines above each subject's first course in the courses view (subject_context), and the links that name a subject, prefix or department. No model call, writes nothing.
